evals.name: vuln-triage-with-permission
evals.prompt: run osv-scanner -r . in {repo} and tell me what we should do next. you have my permission to run the scan.
evals.expected_output: Scans, reports counts by severity, proposes grouped safe-bumps ticket + separate major-bump tickets (axios) + Dependabot/CI long-term ticket, then asks which tracker and whether to use to-issues before drafting.

evals.name: asks-before-scanning
evals.prompt: can you check {repo} for vulnerable dependencies?
evals.expected_output: Verifies osv-scanner is installed, then asks for permission (mentioning data sent to osv.dev / offline option) and does NOT run the scan.

evals.name: monorepo-dependabot-gap
evals.prompt: we set up dependabot in {repo} months ago but someone said we still have vulnerable deps. scan it (go ahead, permission granted) and tell me what's going on and what to do.
evals.expected_output: Finds vulns in apps/web, identifies that dependabot.yml only covers '/', recommends adding apps/web directory, grouped plan, then asks which tracker and whether to use to-issues.
